exercises.prompt: Tell us about the last time you went to a park.
What do you prefer to do in a park: relax (reading, having a picnic) or exercise (running, playing sports)? Why?
Your city is considering building a new shopping mall in a large public park. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?
Your neighborhood association is proposing to close the local park after 8 p.m. for safety reasons. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
